### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `net/wireless/core.c` and `net/wireless/pmsr.c` are closely related as they work together to resolve a deadlock issue that arises when destroying a wireless device interface. The addition of `flush_work` in `core.c` ensures that any ongoing work is completed before the interface is unregistered. Meanwhile, the refactoring in `pmsr.c` allows for direct handling of the abort logic without scheduling work that could lead to deadlocks, as the lock is already held when the interface is being destroyed.
